title: "عبّاس چلے آنا"

romanLyrics: |-
  1
  Saqqa se Sakina ki jo dekhi na gayi pyas
  Darya ki taraf dekha tu barhney laga ahsas
  Mashkeza uthaye hoye hathoon mein basad yaas
  Kuhram tha jab khaimay se jane lagay Abbas
  Bhai se galay mil ke yeh bhai ne pukara
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko

  2
  Jab tum ko pukaron ga main maqtal mein akela
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko
  Che mah jisay rakha hai seene se laga kar
  Kis tarha solaon ossay garam zameen par
  Asghar ka gala teer se jis waqt chiday ga
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko

  3
  Seene mein sina kha ke jo mar jaein gay Akbar
  Main girtay sanbhaltay hoye pohancho ga wahan par
  Kis tarha uthaon ga jawaan betay ka lasha
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko
  Jab Shimar chalaye ga mere halq pe khanjar
  Bas hoga tera naam mere zakhmi labon par

  4
  Telay se pukarey jo tumhein sani-e-Zahra
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko
  Aayi hai teri aas pe ghar chor ke Zainab
  Woh kis ko bulaye gi chaley jao gay tum jab
  Cheeney ga rida sar pe laeen mar ke neza
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko

  5
  Zakhmi na hoon rukhsar bacha lena khudara
  Ro ro ke pukarey gi woh bas naam tumhara
  Jab Shimar meri bachi ko marey ga tamacha
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko
  Zanjeer jakar rakhay gi Abid ke badan ko
  Woh qabar mein kis tarha utaray ga behan ko

  6
  Jab qaid mein dafnaye Sakina ka janaza
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko
  Zeeshan-o- Wajih seene se Ghazi ko laga kar
  Rukhsat kiya Shabbir ne khaimon se yeh keh kar
  Jab rah mein naqay se girey bali Sakina
  Abbas Abbas chaley aana oss waqt madad ko
---

اصغر کا گلا تیر سے جس وقت چھدے گا

عبّاس عبّاس چلے آنا اس وقت مدد کو
آئی ہے تیری آس پہ گھر چھوڑ کے زینب

عبّاس عبّاس چلے آنا اس وقت مدد کو

زخمی نہ ہوں رخسار بچا لینا خدارا
رو رو کے پکارے گی وہ بس نام تمہارا

جب قید میں دفنائے سکینہ کا جنازہ

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/abbas-chale-ana.md')
before = p.read_bytes()
header, roman_and_body = before.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
old_roman, body = roman_and_body.split(b'---\\n', 1)
roman = \"\"\"  1
  Saqqa se Sakina ki jo dekhi na gayi pyaas
  Darya ki taraf dekha to barhne laga ehsaas
  Mashkiza uthaaye hue haathoṅ mein basad yaas
  Kohraam tha jab khaime se jaane lage Abbas
  Bhai se gale mil ke yeh bhai ne pukaara
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko

  2
  Jab tum ko pukaaruṅ ga main maqtal mein akela
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko
  Chhe maah jise rakha hai sine se laga kar
  Kis tarah sulaauṅ use garam zamin par
  Asghar ka gala tir se jis waqt chhide ga
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko

  3
  Sine mein sinaaṅ kha ke jo mar jaaeṅ ge Akbar
  Main girte sambhalte hue pahunchuṅ ga wahaaṅ par
  Kis tarah uthaauṅ ga jawaan bete ka laasha
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko
  Jab Shimar chalaaye ga mere halq pe khanjar
  Bas hoga tera naam mere zakhmi laboṅ par

  4
  Tile se pukaare jo tumheṅ saani-e-Zahra
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko
  Aai hai teri aas pe ghar chhor ke Zainab
  Woh kis ko bulaaye gi chale jaao ge tum jab
  Chhine ga rida sar pe laeeṅ maar ke neza
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko

  5
  Zakhmi na hoṅ rukhsaar bacha lena khudaara
  Ro ro ke pukaare gi woh bas naam tumhaara
  Jab Shimar meri bachi ko maare ga tamaacha
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko
  Zanjir jakar rakhe gi Abid ke badan ko
  Woh qabr mein kis tarah utaare ga bahan ko

  6
  Jab qaid mein dafnaaye Sakina ka janaaza
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko
  Zeeshaan o Wajih sine se Ghazi ko laga kar
  Rukhsat kiya Shabbir ne khaimoṅ se yeh keh kar
  Jab raah mein naaqe se gire baali Sakina
  Abbas Abbas chale aana us waqt madad ko
\"\"\".replace('laeeṅ', 'laiṅ').encode()
p.write_bytes(header + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman + b'---\\n' + body)
result = p.read_bytes()
assert result.split(b'---\\n', 2)[2] == before.split(b'---\\n', 2)[2]
assert result.split(b'romanLyrics:', 1)[0] == header
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')] == [7] * 6
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in roman.decode())
PY"
